summary: Tested MCP OAuth 2.1 implementation: all 16 backend API tests pass (discovery endpoints, Bearer auth, authorize page, admin token management). Frontend had a critical compilation error due to duplicate component code in AdminMcpPage.jsx — fixed by removing the orphaned old version (lines 289-527). After fix, UI renders correctly with all required elements.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: File had duplicate component code — two export default declarations causing SyntaxError 'api has already been declared' compilation failure. Removed orphaned old version (lines 289-527).

critical_code_review_comments: AdminMcpPage.jsx had duplicate component code (old + new version appended together) causing compile failure. Fixed by removing old version.

Frontend: AdminMcpPage at /admin/mcp shows OAuth section with oauth-url, copy-oauth-url-btn, oauth-tokens-list; legacy mcp-key-section with generate/revoke buttons. rca_of_issue: AdminMcpPage.jsx file had the new OAuth component (lines 1-288) followed immediately by the beginning of the old component (imports + component code without the closing bracket match, lines 289-527). This happened because the new version was prepended to the file without removing the old one. The duplicate import of 'api' at line 289 caused babel to throw SyntaxError. Fix: removed all code after the closing brace at line 288.
